query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules) as total_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM molecules_recettes) as linked_molecules,
  ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM molecules_recettes) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules), 1) as coverage_percent
